title: example 105 fix-property-before: its receipt bundles the JVM controls' and the verifier's raw streams (review item 5)
description: The user's review item 5 of 2026-11-15 (llm-dlc/loops/example-targets.md, Progress): ingestion now copies each record's stdout and stderr and the runner's controls.json and verifier.json into the receipt's records/, each cut to 512 KiB, with records/streams.json giving every one's source, whole size and sha256. The for-review list found that gate A5's receipts didn't hold what the JVM controls observed, so the JVM side of the witness was the job's, not the receipt's. Step 1 reruns task fix-property-before of example 105 unchanged (build.py 105 --task fix-property-before: claim 8a4071f6a417d239, upstream Maven build on JDK 11, native, strict, expected refuted with the witness pow(-2, 31)), adding a third receipt beside the two kept. Step 2 reads the new receipt offline with examples/tools/targets/receipt_streams.py and exits 1 unless every stage's stdout and stderr (the controls on JDK 21 and 25, and the verifier), records/controls.json and records/verifier.json are in its bundle. No claim, expectation or verdict changes.
